findings.summary: The append-only route ledger becomes permanently unreadable when its first revision falls outside the existing bounded comment tail.
evidence: Verification: src/FS.GG.Coord.Cli/Client.fs at exact commit 9f259a689485f9e2e66b52ad929fb7e0b091c54f calls Reads.recentCommentBodies with DeliveryRouteCommentWindow = 100 at every route read and write boundary, including lines 917, 927, 10320, and 10376.

Verification: src/FS.GG.Coord.GitHub/Reads.fs:794-818 documents that recentCommentBodies returns only the oldest-to-newest tail of the last limit comments and that its recovery argument assumes a caller needs only the latest marker and can post a fresh reaffirmation.

Verification: src/FS.GG.Coord.Core/StructuredDecision.fs:85-96 validates the observed list from expected revision index + 1, requires revision 1 first, and binds every previousDigest to the preceding observed record. A tail beginning at revision 2 therefore cannot validate, and appending another revision cannot restore the missing prefix.

Verification: tests at exact commit 9f259a689485f9e2e66b52ad929fb7e0b091c54f cover short chains and the migrated writes harness but contain no chain whose first revision has fallen outside the 100-comment production window or a recovery from that state.
resolution_evidence: Verification: unresolved at the initial review; the worker accepted a repair requiring a complete/paginated v2 ledger read or a verifiable checkpoint design plus a greater-than-window refusal/recovery test.

Verification: repair-round-1 commit 7521234bcebbd96386abedfe990333b1626344a4 replaces every effective route read and append boundary with the complete paginated Reads.commentBodies adapter; no Client.fs production call to recentCommentBodies remains.

Verification: DeliveryRouteCliTests at repair-round-1 exact head exercise a revision-1 record buried behind 100 narrative comments and a wholly buried ledger that remains authoritative and accepts the correctly linked revision 2.
Verification: the uninterrupted workflow-derived selector recorded in /tmp/m4-selector-final2.log passed all 48 selected suites at repair-round-1 exact head, including DeliveryRouteCliTests.

findings.summary: Structured-versus-legacy review differences are classified internally but never emitted to an operator or machine consumer.
evidence: Verification: src/FS.GG.Coord.Core/Driver.fs computes LiveReviewComments.EvidenceClassification as legacy-only, structured-only, equivalent, or divergent.

Verification: `rg -n 'EvidenceClassification|evidenceClassification' src tests` at exact commit 9f259a689485f9e2e66b52ad929fb7e0b091c54f finds production use only in the Driver record declaration and assignment; Review.inspect discards the field, while tests read it directly.

Verification: src/FS.GG.Coord.Cli/ReviewApplication.fs:305-347 serializes the review verdict without an evidence-classification field, so the live `review --json` boundary cannot emit an equivalent or divergent dual-read result.
Verification: docs/reports/2026-08-14-090508-coordination-churn-redesign-roadmap.md:169-171 explicitly requires migration to dual-read structured and legacy evidence and emit differences.
resolution_evidence: Verification: unresolved at the initial review; the worker accepted a repair to surface the review classification at the live output boundary and add CLI-level equivalent/divergent coverage.

Verification: repair-round-1 Review.Verdict carries EvidenceClassification into its action key and ReviewApplication emits it in both JSON and text projections, so a changed classification also invalidates a stale action authorization.
Verification: ReviewApplicationTests at exact repair-round-1 head exercise equivalent and divergent dual-read snapshots through the CLI JSON boundary and pin legacy-only text/JSON output.
Verification: the uninterrupted workflow-derived selector recorded in /tmp/m4-selector-final2.log passed all 48 selected suites at repair-round-1 exact head, including ReviewApplicationTests.

findings.summary: The shipped review-authoring contract still directs v1 writes and provides no operational way to construct the required digest-chained v2 records.
evidence: Verification: .agents/skills/pnext-item/SKILL.md:212 at exact commit 9f259a689485f9e2e66b52ad929fb7e0b091c54f still requires the host's exact-SHA fsgg:review-accepted:v1 marker, while the new banner in references/independent-review.md says v1 must not be authored.

Verification: .agents/skills/pnext-item/references/independent-review.md retains copyable v1 templates and later instructions to post or observe v1 acceptance at lines 52 onward, 515, 591, 705, and 745, creating contradictory operator instructions beneath the banner.

Verification: docs/coordination/structured-decisions.md lists v2 fields but does not specify the UTF-8 length framing/canonicalization used by StructuredDecision.reviewDigest or provide a complete record template or generator command.

Verification: `rg -n 'review-decision/v2|StructuredReviewMarker' src` at exact commit 9f259a689485f9e2e66b52ad929fb7e0b091c54f finds only the private review decoder/projection in Driver.fs and the schema constant; no production review serializer or writer exists.
resolution_evidence: Verification: unresolved at the initial review; the worker accepted a repair to make source-owned guidance consistently v2, supply an executable structured review authoring boundary, and prove initial, confirmation, acceptance, and legacy-write-refusal behavior end to end.

Verification: repair-round-1 commit 7521234bcebbd96386abedfe990333b1626344a4 adds `review record`, a canonical encoder, writer guards, source-owned v2 instructions, draft documentation, and v1 write refusal; the guidance contradiction and missing command are repaired.

Verification: repair-round-1 Client.recordReview discards the actual comment URLs before validating the appended record, so caller-supplied initialReview and precedingReview values are not checked against the ledger comments they claim to bind.

Verification: tests/coord-engine-e2e/writes.sh supplies fabricated https://fixture/review/initial and https://fixture/review/confirmation links, while tests/coord-engine-e2e/stateful_server.py returns https://fixture.invalid/issues/42#issuecomment-* URLs; all three writes pass without proving Driver.parseReviewComments accepts the resulting chain. The authoring acceptance remains unresolved.

evidence: Verification: on exact commit 9f259a689485f9e2e66b52ad929fb7e0b091c54f, `python3 scripts/check-kit-published-coherence.py --pr-arm --base ea6a9f7f02fdc6449de652c1cc45b0ce3195f1dd` exited 1 and reported that canonical Kit bytes changed while FS.GG.Kit 0.54.0 is already published.

Verification: the same gate explicitly requires a receiver-visible behavior change to bump the Kit version above 0.54.0 and release the new tag after merge, with the main-only arm proving publication.
Verification: Directory.Build.props:215 and registry/dependencies.yml:901-902 at exact commit 9f259a689485f9e2e66b52ad929fb7e0b091c54f still record coherent-set source/package version 0.54.0.
resolution_evidence: Verification: unresolved at the initial review; the worker accepted the normal coherent-set versioning, merge, release, external feed verification, and recorded-evidence obligation.

Verification: repair-round-1 advances the coherent source version and generated receiver projections to 0.55.0; `python3 scripts/check-kit-published-coherence.py --pr-arm --base ea6a9f7f02fdc6449de652c1cc45b0ce3195f1dd` exits 0 and reports 0.55.0 ahead of published 0.54.0.

Verification: registry/dependencies.yml truthfully leaves package-version at 0.54.0 and no 0.55.0 external feed evidence exists before merge; the normal post-merge coherent-set release and external verification remain required before milestone completion.

findings.summary: The structured v2 ledger cannot represent the documented fresh review chain required after an accepted pull-request head moves.
evidence: Verification: StructuredDecision.validateReviewLedger at repair-round-1 exact commit 7521234bcebbd96386abedfe990333b1626344a4 rejects every initial record after revision 1 and every record after an acceptance record.

Verification: .agents/skills/pnext-item/references/independent-review.md:553-605 requires retaining the accepted old chain and appending a genuinely fresh full review chain on the same pull request after the accepted head moves; Driver.liveReviewComments retains explicit retirement machinery for that behavior.

Verification: new-only review authoring means the documented recovery cannot fall back to a second legacy v1 initial. `review record` validates the complete prior ledger and therefore refuses the fresh initial immediately after structured acceptance.

Verification: `rg -n 'structured|review-decision/v2|StructuredDecision' tests/review-post-acceptance-head-move tests/FS.GG.Coord.Core.Tests/ReviewTests.fs` produced no output at repair-round-1 exact head; existing head-move coverage exercises legacy v1 only.
resolution_evidence: Verification: unresolved at repair round 1; the ledger model and writer need revision-bound chain generations that preserve accepted history, admit the required fresh critic/initial after a real head move, and are covered through structured retirement and final acceptance.
